catalog.model.gemma4E2b.notes: Fastest option. Sees images and video frames, hears audio, thinks when asked.
catalog.model.gemma4E4b.notes: The recommended default: TensorSharp's verified fast-path tier, multimodal, with an optional speculative draft head.
catalog.model.gemma4Size12b.notes: The dense Gemma between E4B and the 26B mixture of experts, in the 2.7 bpw IQ2_M recipe. 4.2 GB of weights, mapped from the file rather than copied, so the model itself costs the phone almost nothing and the 32k window is the larger part of its footprint. Vision and a speculative draft head are optional downloads.
catalog.model.bonsai2Size27b.notes: PrismML's ternary Qwen 3.5 hybrid with Hadamard-rotated weights. The 5.9 GB download is repacked losslessly to about 7.7 GB when it loads, so it is offered only on 16 GB devices. Vision is an optional download.
catalog.model.qwen35Size9b.notes: Strong general model with vision; the projector is optional and costs ~1.8 GB of memory when loaded.
catalog.model.qwen38Size27b.notes: Qwen's dense 27B at four bits: stronger than the 9B at reasoning, coding and agent work, and slower, since all 27B parameters run for every token. Needs 32 GB of memory (a Mac). Vision is an optional download.
catalog.model.museGlimmer30b.notes: A dense 30B that reads images and calls tools. It reasons in its own channel before answering, even with thinking off. Needs 32 GB of memory (a Mac). Vision is an optional download and takes about 8 GB more memory when it is installed.
catalog.model.qwen38FlashNext.notes: Qwen's 125B mixture of experts (6B active per token) at two bits. Needs a 48 GB Mac: the file is 79 GB, and the app reads its experts and its n-gram table from the SSD as tokens need them, so the first answers after loading are slower while those pages warm up. Text only.
catalog.model.qwenImage21.notes: Makes a picture from a description, or edits an attached photo. Needs 24 GB of memory (a Mac).
catalog.license.qwenImage: Qwen Research License (non-commercial); text encoder Apache-2.0
catalog.model.minimaxH3.parameters: 33B audio-video DiT (20B with its AdaLN branches pruned) + Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder
catalog.model.minimaxH3Fl2va.notes: Makes a short video with its own soundtrack from a description, brings an attached photo to life, or runs between two photos (the first and the last frame). Needs 32 GB of memory (a Mac). MiniMax's license does not cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the US.
catalog.model.minimaxH3Ref2va.notes: Makes a short video with its own soundtrack that features the people, things, places or sounds in up to nine attached photos, clips and recordings. Say who or what is in the shot: a reference gives their look, the description puts them in the scene. Needs 32 GB of memory (a Mac). MiniMax's license does not cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the US.
catalog.lora.viggleTurbo.purpose: Pictures and edits in 6 steps instead of 40, close to the full model's quality.
catalog.lora.pruna8Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 8 steps instead of 40.
catalog.lora.pruna5Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 5 steps: the fastest, with visibly lower quality than 8-step.
catalog.lora.funAcc4Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 4 steps. Small text and some edits come out weaker than the full model's.
catalog.lora.filmStills.purpose: The look of a cinematic 35mm film still.
catalog.lora.grainscape.purpose: A grainy, high-ISO 35mm colour-negative film look.
catalog.lora.qualityFix.purpose: A DoRA its author made to correct the model's common flaws. It was tuned for a different sampler than the app's, so judge it on your own pictures.
catalog.license.noneStated: No license stated by the author
catalog.lora.detailEnhancer.purpose: Finer detail and cleaner textures for an attached picture, keeping its composition.
catalog.lora.naturalExposure.purpose: Corrects an attached photo's exposure to a balanced, neutral one.
catalog.lora.objectRemover.purpose: Removes what is inside red boxes drawn on an attached photo and fills in the background. It does not manage every photo, so check the result.
catalog.lora.objectMover.purpose: Moves the object in one red box drawn on an attached photo to the spot marked by a second red box.
catalog.lora.animeConsistency.purpose: Keeps an anime character the same when an attached picture is edited into a new pose, view or expression. Experimental.
